The person asks: "I used Google Antigravity to fix the app, it is now a functional MVP, but has some rough edges to work out...

Rename the header to FireCraft Studio - Open Source bitmap and vector Graphics Editor.
And the splash screen should be separate from the app itself (it loads before it).
As for the welcome screen in the app, please center it...
Zoom in and out doesn't seem to be working correctly...

I still want a splash screen on launch like Fireworks CS6 does already, even if just a placeholder and it should be animated and transparent (but I will create the improved graphic later); use "C:\Repos\FireCraft-CraftAnything-Experiment\screenshots\FireCraft Flame Tech Logo.png" for now (though it's not great).

For one, C:\Repos\FireCraft has a much more feature complete menu and dynamic right click context menu system, etc. A lot of visual elements are not well polished and it's incomplete in a lot of areas, but is worth inspecting for areas of improvement to this version and implementation, etc.

I changed my mind, default middle mouse scroll should do normal scroll (like in a web browser) for up/down, then adding shift+scroll should change the scroll to horizontal (shift often reverses a command, so it's fitting). CTRL+scroll should zoom in and out, focusing on where the cursor is (you zoom into where the cursor is pointing, etc.). And make ALT+middle click enables hand selection/movement around the page.

Center the splash page to the center of the screen dynamically and open center the app to the center of the screen as well (currently goes to the left). But note it should remember the last location it loaded to and be persistent... but it doesn't seem to do that either. Adobe Fireworks CS6 supports snapping and grouping windows together, with the ability to move around the windows and so on... improve this functionality... also, some Windows can be moved around and if over the canvas, then it highlights selected areas on the page... and if I close any of the windows with the "x" it closes the entire app (a bug)... also, Window --> "Reset Workspace Layout" doesn't do anything at all. And selecting the theme from the drop down menu doesn't seem to align with the dedicated drop down them menu...

Look and feel needs refinement and I was somewhat wrong, I can drag and drop elements around if I specifically drag the label (should be the entire bar) and it doesn't animate/render correctly where it's intuitive, work needs to go into the workflow and functionality, along with an audit."
